tools.name: explain_savings_club
tools.description: Savings Club's own approved explanation of a topic: how it works, the fee, the ranking, the 15th, the common fund, preparing for the 15th, advance payments, referrals, where the money is held, joining, half payment, using a voucher, leaving, reaching a person, similar programs, what you can buy, the

tools.name: estimate_membership
tools.description: Monthly payment, flat fee and total, in dollars, for a vehicle price over the 96-month membership, from the same calculation the Savings Club contract uses, plus the link to sign up. 96 months is the only term; paying off sooner is allowed. A member's referral code lowers the flat fee.

tools.name: compare_with_savings_club
tools.description: Savings Club's total for a vehicle price over its 96-month membership, side by side with another way to finance it: the average bank auto loan for each credit tier (Experian, State of the Automotive Finance Market), a loan quote the person already has, or a Brazilian consórcio (Banco Central figures

tools.name: vehicle_costs_by_state
tools.description: What buying a passenger car from a dealer costs on top of the price in a US state or DC: sales or title tax, title and registration fees, the doc fee cap, how optional add-ons are taxed, inspections and buyer protections, each from a state source with the date it was checked.

tools.name: next_selection
tools.description: When the next voucher selection runs, how long until then, where to watch it live, and how to prepare.

tools.name: talk_to_a_person
tools.description: Asks a person from Savings Club to contact the user, with the name, phone and details the user provides. Sends those details to Savings Club's CRM.

tools.name: email_me_this
tools.description: Emails the user a Savings Club estimate for a vehicle price and term, at the address they typed, and records them in Savings Club's CRM as interested.

tools.name: verify_a_certificate
tools.description: Confirms live from verify.savings.club whether a Savings Club beneficiary certificate is genuine and current, from the link its QR code opens. It gives the certificate number, the beneficiary, the club and the membership's standing. Anyone may use it, such as a dealer shown the certificate.
